heroSubtitle: From foundation to finishes — every detail considered, every deadline met.
whoWeAreDesc: A company built to build differently — with the standards of those who build to last.
experienceDesc: We provide our Technical Team, which studies the most favourable and appropriate technical solutions for each project.
qualityDesc: We work continuously with dedication to ensure the satisfaction of our clients.
commitmentDesc: Deadlines met. Aware of the importance of each investment, we make sure to fulfil what was agreed.
valueExclusivityDesc: Each project is unique. There are no off-the-shelf solutions — only answers tailored to each client.
valueTransparencyDesc: Clear budgets, honest timelines and direct communication at every stage of the build.
valueInnovationDesc: We adopt technologies like LSF because we believe building better starts with building differently.
valueQualityDesc: No project is too small. The same level of rigour applies whether it's a renovation or a home built from scratch.
historyP1: Eeengenharia was born from the belief that building well is more than following blueprints — it's understanding what each client wants to leave behind.
historyP2: Specialised in LSF construction and renovation, we operate in residential, commercial and industrial projects with our own technical team and strategic partnerships that ensure rigour at every stage.
historyP3: From the first sketch to handing over the keys, we follow every build with the same attention to detail — because we know the result will last decades.
teamP1: At Eengenharia, we have a highly qualified multidisciplinary team, specialised in all areas of civil construction, including architecture, civil engineering and project management.
teamP2: We work closely with various partners and suppliers to ensure the provision of services and materials essential to each project, including civil construction, electricity, plumbing, metalwork, carpentry, and more.

serviceDescMoradias: We build your home from the ground up with LSF (Light Steel Framing) technology: lighter structures, faster to assemble and with excellent thermal and acoustic performance. We handle everything, from foundation to finishes, on schedule.
serviceDescRemodelacoes: We renovate and transform indoor and outdoor spaces — kitchens, bathrooms, extensions or full refurbishments. Quality materials and careful finishes, tailored to your budget.
serviceDescProjetos: We develop the architectural and engineering project and handle all licensing with the authorities. We manage the bureaucracy from start to finish so you don't have to worry.
